name: Mud in the Memory
source:
You've called your best friend to explain what happened.

You know exactly what you did.

Or...do yo?

[From [url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/mud-in-the-memory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你拨通了挚友的电话，想向对方解释刚刚发生的一切。

你对自己做过的事心知肚明。

还是说……你真的清楚吗？

[摘自[url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/mud-in-the-memory]itch.io[/url]]
